subject: Re: Packaging ask — HSM seats + extended audit logs (pricing request)
messages:
From: Maya Rosen <maya.rosen@bluehaven-med.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bluehaven-med.com
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Compliance packaging — need pricing split for HSM + audit logs

Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. BlueHaven is excited about the latency profile and the model routing features, but procurement needs a clear breakdown for two items before we move to legal:

1) HSM seats vs. per-token KMS: we expect one physically provisioned HSM (FIPS/HSM-backed key escrow) for patient-identifiable workflows and would like pricing options that (a) amortize implementation over 12 months and (b) show a blended per-token uplift for fallback routing.

2) Audit log retention: we need a 7-year retention option for audit logs (HIPAA-driven) and a separate 90-day low-cost tier for dev/test traffic. Please show line items for storage, retrieval SLA, and any query/export fees.

We also want to understand what crediting or one-time concessions you can offer for a three-quarter committed volume (we are targeting Q3–Q4 ramp to ~1B tokens/month). Procurement deadline: EOD 5/18 PT.

Can you provide a short commercial note and the sample SLA your legal team prefers to see? I attached the RFI answers template.

Appreciate it —
Maya Rosen
Director, Procurement
BlueHaven Medical

Attachment: BlueHaven-RFI-answers.xlsx (XLSX, 210KB)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rosen <maya.rosen@bluehaven-med.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging — need pricing split for HSM + audit logs

Maya —

Thanks for the clear ask and the RFI. I pulled together an initial commercial sketch below and attached our standard SLA draft and a small evidence bundle that shows audit exports (so your security folks see the format). High-level options:

A) HSM approach (recommended for production PHI):
  • One dedicated HSM cluster (annualized) — USD 85,000/yr (includes key management integration, HSM seats, basic monitoring).
  • Fallback per-token KMS uplift (for cross-region failover): +0.4¢/1k tokens when routed to software KMS variant.
  • Implementation professional services (one-time): USD 18k (can be amortized across year 1).

B) Audit log retention tiers:
  • 90-day dev/test tier — USD 0.002/GB-month (cheaper warm storage, limited query SLA).
  • 7-year archive tier — USD 0.045/GB-month (cold, retrieval within 48hrs).
  • Ad-hoc exports (on-demand full export to SFTP) — USD 250 per export job.

Crediting/concession options for a 9-month committed ramp to 1B tokens/month:
  • Up to 12% one-time credit applied to first 3 months of usage to offset implementation and HSM setup.
  • If you commit to a 12-month reserved seat for HSM payment (annual pre-pay), we can reduce the HSM line to USD 70,000/yr.

I realize you need this quick. I pulled our legal-friendly SLA and an example audit export bundle — attaching both. If you want, we can give a quant model by tomorrow that shows blended token economics (with fallback uplift) for your projected ramp.

Next steps I propose:
  1) I’ll send a short commercial term sheet today for procurement.
  2) Ben — can you confirm whether finance can extend the 12% credit up to 15% if BH signs a 12-month committed capacity?
  3) Irene — can you attach the sample evidence of long-term retention (indexing approach) for BlueHaven security?

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood-SLA-draft.pdf (PDF, 190KB); audit-evidence-sample.zip (ZIP, 3.4MB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging — need pricing split for HSM + audit logs

Jonas —

Finance can be flexible but we need to stay within program economics. We can approve a 15% one-time implementation credit if all three conditions are met:
  1) 12-month committed spend with a minimum of 9 months of ramp to the 1B tokens/month target,
  2) Annual pre-pay on the HSM (or equivalent MO),
  3) No additional infra or professional services concessions beyond the initial PS line.

If BlueHaven wants the blended token uplift softened (from 0.4¢ to 0.25¢/1k tokens), we need to increase the reserved commit or move to a 15-month minimum.

Irene — please send the retention-evidence artifacts so we can include them in the procurement packet.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging — need pricing split for HSM + audit logs

Jonas / Ben —

Attaching the long-retention export sample and internal note on indexing strategy (shows how we shard indexes for 7-year retention to keep query latency predictable). Two callouts for procurement/security:
  • We can offer a 7-year immutable archive with write-once retention tags (compliant with common audit standards).
  • For the dev/test 90-day tier, we throttle export jobs to avoid accidental mass egress costs.

I’ve added a short paragraph you can paste into the term sheet explaining our incident response SLAs tied to audit log integrity.

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention-indexing-note.pdf (PDF, 78KB); long-retention-sample.tar.gz (TAR.GZ, 12MB)

From: Maya Rosen <maya.rosen@bluehaven-med.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bluehaven-med.com
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging — need pricing split for HSM + audit logs

Jonas / Ben / Irene —

Thanks — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. Procurement has two quick clarifying asks before we circulate to legal:
  1) Can the 15% one-time credit be triggered by signature on a letter of intent (LOI) + proof of pre-pay, rather than full contract signature? Our legal team prefers LOIs for quick commercial alignment.
  2) For the export fee, will you accept a capped monthly export budget (e.g., $1,500/month) for frequent exports during onboarding until we finalize retention flows?

If you can confirm those two items today, procurement will send the LOI template and we’ll aim to loop in legal next week.

Best —
Maya Rosen
Director, Procurement
BlueHaven Medical
